operating_point.platform: CPU; gates and controls on GitHub runners (4 vCPU, 16 GB), costs on runners with node_measure.py (one process an arm, fwd and rev in one process on one CPU); compile-only estimates on the laptop
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: gates: camera spike R1's ballistic case at 160x120 (fx = fy = 750 px, a 20 um steel ball moving along a 60 um bore tube, wall 10 um absorbing 3000/m, seen across from 1 mm, base step 1 ms), J = sum over 12 steps of |soft centroid - projected centre|^2, in v0x, z0, fy, cy, k1; arms reset (step 0), continued (after 6 steps), overridden (after 6 steps, fy written 3 px over the structure's numbers), chunked (after 6 steps, three chunks of 4 as a CALLBACK controller's run); reverse through MIME's differentiated_run (checkpointed chunks), forward mode through its one chunk. Costs: the same scene at 320x240 and 640x480, a frame every step, the ball crossing about 60 um over the run, reverse in fy of the sum of the final state
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: the gates' test runs R1's fixed point (seed 0): deterministic per CPU; the controls' rates (detection_rate.py) draw a point per run (DETECTION_SEED: x0 in [-45, 0] um, |z0| in [8, 30] um, speed 0.5 to 3 mm/s, period 2 to 4 steps), each run judging both dtypes

gate_1_checkpoints.claim: each corner sub-sample and the branch that makes the static structure checkpointed take the in-loop camera's reverse tape from thousands of frames a step to tens, and change no program that takes no reverse derivative
gate_1_checkpoints.kind: estimates (XLA's compile-only memory analysis) and equality (forward programs bit for bit)
gate_1_checkpoints.case: explore-style compile of differentiated_run(checkpoint=True) in fy at 320x240 x 10 steps, float64, head without and with the checkpoints

prediction.unit: GB at 320x240 x 10 steps (from about 18 without)
prediction.why: R1's s+c 0.41 GB; this branch's 160x120 0.116 GB times four frames' size

gate_1_checkpoints.metric: XLA's compiled bytes of the reverse program; then the process's measured peak (gate 4)

control.plant: none: the base head (4ce71c6e) is the other arm, about 18 GB predicted

gate_1_checkpoints.if_wrong: a residual R1 did not see (the run-constant's read branch); print_saved_residuals at 64 px
gate_1_checkpoints.cannot_discriminate_if: both programs compile to the same bytes (the checkpoint not reached by reverse mode)

gate_2_refusal.claim: a reverse derivative through the camera that would not fit the memory a run can have is refused by name (camera.reverse-memory), naming the offline renderer, before it compiles; one that fits is not
gate_2_refusal.kind: bounds (the estimate is at least every measured peak) and acceptance (the refusal fires)
gate_2_refusal.case: CameraNode.derivative_problem's formula: frames of the run's dtype, a constant, a chunk start's state per chunk and a tape per step of a chunk, fitted to the measured peaks of gate 4 and checked on the sizes left out of the fit

prediction.unit: estimate over measured peak, every arm (never under 1: an underestimate fails)
prediction.why: a least-squares fit with its margin set at the largest miss, as the near field's MEMORY_MARGIN

gate_2_refusal.metric: measured process peak against the estimate

control.plant: a run of 10^6 steps at 4096x3072 (refused anywhere) and the done case's 160x120 x 12 steps (passes anywhere); the threshold itself with device_memory planted just under and just over the estimate

gate_2_refusal.if_wrong: an underestimate on a held-out size: the tape grows with something the formula does not count (subjects, sub-frames)
gate_2_refusal.cannot_discriminate_if: the planted memory is not what the check reads

gate_3_reverse_gates.claim: reverse mode through the camera equals forward mode (T1, H2) and central differences (T2; in float32 only where they discriminate, else T3: float32 against float64), and a held step's derivative is its frame's (H1), from the run's start, from a continued state with the tree's structure or a leaf written over, and over a CALLBACK controller's chunks, in both dtypes
gate_3_reverse_gates.kind: equality to rounding (T1, H1, H2, T3) and bounds (T2)

prediction.unit: largest error over its tolerance, every check, every arm, both dtypes
prediction.why: R1's largest T2 0.44 of its bound, T1 1.48 eps S against 128; H2 on its terms' scale clears R1's one flagged draw; the continued and chunked arms read the same structure the run-constant PR made right in forward mode

gate_3_reverse_gates.float32_where_central_differences_cannot: predicted: nowhere at the fixed point (R1's float32 relative bounds 0.16 to 3.9 %, under DISCRIMINATES = 10 %); on the controls' drawn points at most one parameter in ten (guess), judged by T3, which runs on every float32 parameter anyway
gate_3_reverse_gates.T3_tolerance: 128 eps32 S + 1.5 sqrt(160 eps32) S = 6.5e-3 S (the chain's rounding and the disc's d^(3/2) rise over float32's forward rounding of an edge, about 160 eps32 px); predicted gap at most 0.3 of it
gate_3_reverse_gates.metric: each check's error over its tolerance

control.plant: edge-stop (stop_gradient on the ball's exact disc coverage), structure-stop (on the tree's structure, the run-constant's derivative), made-stop (on the structure a frame step makes: the overridden arm's path), held-stop (on the held frame)
control.expected_rate: edge-stop and held-stop 30/30 in each arm; structure-stop 30/30 in reset, continued and chunked; made-stop 30/30 in overridden
control.resolution: discriminating_range.py over the structure's share scaled by (1 - s): predicted caught every draw down to s of about 0.1 of the share in f64

gate_3_reverse_gates.if_wrong: a clean flag: classify by CLAUDE.md's five causes before any tolerance moves; a missed plant: the check that should have caught it cannot discriminate there
gate_3_reverse_gates.cannot_discriminate_if: a plant's path is not taken in the arm (structure-stop in the overridden arm, made-stop elsewhere): those pairs are not counted

gate_4_costs.claim: reverse mode's peak memory and time a step against forward at 320x240 and 640x480 over 10, 100 and 1000 steps
gate_4_costs.case: node_measure.py --reverse camera:.fy (MIME's differentiated run, checkpointed), one arm a process on a runner

prediction.unit: rev/fwd time a step at 1000 steps (float64); peaks 2 to 6 GiB at 320, 3 to 7 GiB at 640, 1000 steps
prediction.why: R1's s+c and r+s+c rows; the run-constant removes the carried cache from the tape (about a third of s+c's per-step tape at 640, R1), so peaks at or under R1's

gate_4_costs.metric: node_measure's reverse_peak_mib and reverse steady time over forward steady time, same process
gate_4_costs.if_wrong: a size over 12 GiB: the refusal's threshold is then what a runner can take, and the docs say so

bits.cases: every forward program bit for bit, base (camera/run-constant 4ce71c6e) against head: the camera's saved cases (camera_scene, camera_on_gantry) from step 0 and continued, f64 and f32; script A f64 and f32; and the forward-mode derivative of the continued gate (jvp); the reverse program changes (checkpoints)
bits.prediction: every forward array np.array_equal; the reverse program's gradient within T1's bound of the base's, not bit for bit
